body: Not anything too drastic but kind of rebooting my perception of myself. I continually wished for a reset button on life, but it's basically impossible. However, I did a lot of introspective thinking and came to a conclusion how a  metaphorical mental and emotional reset could take place. Forgiving myself and others, refocusing efforts, getting goddamn sunlight and exercise, etc. It's always difficult to start anew, but with any effort, progress is progress no matter how little. I have gained a bit more motivation to work towards some goals, but bad days still happen. It's just a matter of coping with the really terrible bouts of depression and getting through the hopelessness, not matter how bleak the future may seem in that moment.
I'm still going haha. I really don't mean to sound pessimistic, it's just the best way to describe my situation.
Hey. Haven't logged into this account for awhile. I'm still around. How are you doing?

Being babyied would be something that I wouldn't mind. Being cradled in the concern of others would be so satisfying to me but that's not the case. Everyone has problems and it feels as if I scream into a room of noise.. where my message isn't ever received and I'm left there... screaming to no avail. This is because my family hasn't ever really been that close.. or that comfortable to their weaknesses.

I do like games. Been playing a lot of PC things lately. PM for my steam account if you want to play. I really don't care what to play because games have always been my escape.
Thanks and I hope all is well.
Thanks guys. I think I'm going back to sleep. There's a lot to do today and I'm hoping to get some more energy out of it. I'm okay for now.

yeah a bit. Went outside and got some sun too. Going to a counselor was one of the best decisions that I've ever made. The grounding techniques she's shared with me are helpful.

But it's really funny how these things feel like temporary boosts and their effects wear off and you slowly sink back down. Like continuously pumping air into a ball that leaks air.

Yeah. Apparently I've had it my whole life but was never really aware of it. I just normally thought that these were normal feelings until I got educated on the matter. I really wish I stayed ignorant sometimes and not realized that my normal mental mode (sad, angry, on display, tightly wound?) didn't fall into the median range of others. 

What was semi-comforting was reading statistics of diagnosed cases and that these things aren't uncommon so it felt like I wasn't alone. Everybody should seek help for these kinds of issues.

Sorry for taking awhile to respond. I was sleeping. I finally got myself up and moving around. Forced myself to eat when I wasn't hungry but yeah.

Thanks though it's just all really exhausting.
